findings.claim: The review diff omits the new Web-04 implementation units, so the submitted patch cannot compile or satisfy the schema, store, and mounted HTTP acceptance criteria.
findings.evidence: The packet adds `pub mod document_upload;` here, `pub mod documents;` in `crates/aso-server-axum/src/routes/mod.rs`, `pub mod document_store;` in `crates/aso-web-server/src/adapters/mod.rs`, and an `include_str!` for `migrations/server/2026090620_document_upload_schema.sql`, but the packet contains no diff block for `crates/aso-host/src/document_upload.rs`, `crates/aso-server-axum/src/routes/documents.rs`, `crates/aso-web-server/src/adapters/document_store.rs`, or that migration. It also omits all three named Web-04 verification scripts. Applying only the packet therefore leaves unresolved Rust modules and a missing compile-time migration include, while criteria 1.2-1.4 require those exact implementation surfaces.
findings.suggested_fix: Add every new Web-04 source, migration, and verification file to the reviewed diff, regenerate the packet from the complete candidate, and rerun the adversarial review against that exact diff.

findings.claim: Document inspection computes the page count and then discards it, so committed metadata cannot preserve the verified page count for multi-page uploads.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion 1.3 requires page verification. `inspect_document_upload(command.media_type, &bytes)?;` returns the verified `usize` page count, but the return value is not assigned. The subsequent `reserve_document_upload_staging` call binds command/document/case IDs, revisions, type key, name, effective date, media type, byte size, digest, and data; it never binds the computed page count. PostgreSQL is not given the bytes, so it cannot derive the discarded value independently.
findings.suggested_fix: Capture the inspection result, include it in the staging reservation and committed document metadata, and add a mounted service test proving a multi-page PDF and form-feed-delimited text upload return their exact page counts after commit and retry.
